channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: From the UK to the Gulf, are US overseas bases becoming liabilities?
item.description: For decades, these bases allowed the US to wage faraway wars. Now, Iran has changed that calculation.

item.title: Ten police officers, 18 fighters killed in northwest Pakistan attack
item.description: Officers were returning from a mine in Kohat district when fighters opened fire on them, authorities say.

item.title: Photos: Protesters clash with police after housing cost rallies in Spain
item.description: Anger over housing affordability and purchasing power leads to clashes amid Spain's first general strike in 14 years.

item.title: Iran open to deal if US ‘refrains from excessive demands’, says Ghalibaf
item.description: Iran’s chief negotiator says Iran is open to a deal if the US refrains from creating distrust and excessive demands.

item.title: Fighting intensifies in Yemen as Houthis deny targeting Mecca
item.description: World Health Organization says more than 320,000 people have been displaced in Yemen fighting since August 1.

item.title: Iran’s chief negotiator tells Al Jazeera ‘ball in US court’
item.description: Iran’s chief negotiator says it’s up to the US to answer Iran’s position in the latest round of peace talks.

item.title: Amnesty says UN, South Sudan officials failed to prevent village massacre
item.description: Peacekeepers knew of likely raid on Abiemnom, where more than 200 people were killed, according to rights group report.

item.title: Iran warns of expanded retaliation as Israel reportedly readies to attack
item.description: Israeli security cabinet orders military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran, Israeli media reports.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
item.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
item.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
